about_item: BATH TIME MADE EASY: Bathe your cat or dog indoors or outdoors without the backache - or the mess - with 360-degree access to your pet. Portable bathing and grooming tub fits inside your bathtub or shower and helps you keep your pet clean while conserving water. When finished bathing,use the attached stretchable drain hose to drain into your tub or shower, or a bucket

PERFECT WASHING & GROOMING HEIGHT: No more backache - the elevated tub makes bathing and grooming easy on your back and knees by putting your pet at the perfect height - just short of 35 inches. Two side pockets store shampoo and other bathing or grooming essentials within easy reach

FOLDS IN SECONDS:Fold and unfold the tub with one hand thanks to its lightweight construction and patented folding mechanism. Simply wipe the tub dry and pull the handle in the middle to fold it from 33" to just shy of 6" wide for easy storage. The tub's legs are easily removed to save even more space during storage and transport

PERFECT FOR SMALL & MEDIUM SIZE DOGS & CATS:The basin measures 33" long, 17.8" wide and 11.5" deep, providing plenty of space for your furry pal. Included two-point leash restraint with adjustable collar can make showering your pet safer and more convenient. Ideal for most pets up to 40 pounds

LIGHTWEIGHT&DURABLE DESIGN: The basin is made of marine grade PVC, which is rugged, easy-to-clean,and resistant to wear from paws and claws.The frame is made of stainless aluminum tubing and weighs less than 11 lbs total, yet supports more than 130 lbs (including water) and remains steady and safe during bathing and grooming. Dimensions:35.7"L x 20.7"W x 35"H(unfolded); 2 year manufacturer warranty

authors_reviews.title: Get this tub
authors_reviews.text: Before moving we could bathe our Frenchies in our oversized kitchen sink. It wasn't alway neat or easy but it got the job done without needing to bend over for the time it takes to wash two wiggly, willful dogs. After moving, the oversized sink was a memory and back to the tub we went. Finally, we decided to invest in a standing tub to save our backs and our sanity. The tub arrived mostly fully set up, we just needed to install the legs, very simple. We could tell the tub was durable and well made though it is lightweight and easy to carry. We have a normal sized tub (19" wide) and it fit with ease. It is simple to open and there was no need to adjust anything--you pretty much can use it right out of the box. The tub comes complete with everything you need (but shampoo). We placed our bottle of shampoo, a washcloth and a small brush in the one side pocket (there are two). The drainage hose is already connected (there is also a spare hose) and a short leash/collar set-up attached to the side which can be removed, which we did since our dogs weren't tempted to jump out of the tub. It was so simple to wet them down, soap them up and rinse them off. The whole procedure took us less than 45 minutes to bathe two dogs from start to finish. And no backaches or frayed tempers. We couldn't be more pleased with our purchase. The tub breaks down easily with just a pull up of the interior handle and the whole thing once closed fits easily into a closet, you can even remove the legs if necessary. The tub is a great value and we heartily recommend it. The only thing I wish is that we would have purchased it sooner. Five stars!
authors_reviews.author: Cynthia V

authors_reviews.title: Excellent pet tub!
authors_reviews.text: I cannot applaud this dog tub enough. My husband & I recently adopted a rescue Maltipoo. He weighs about 14 lbs & has a soft white coat. We knew he would need frequent bathing, in between grooming sessions, so I ordered this tub. It is very sturdy, quite roomy & the heavy duty “rubber like” plastic tub is superior quality. Due to its size, it takes up a lot of shower space, leaving me a small area to stand. Please check measurements before ordering. It’s height makes it convenient to use with our hand held, pull out shower head attachment & rinsing is easy. This pet tub should sit in a bathtub & the sides are high enough to prevent a pet from easily jumping out, of course, as with a child, never leave a pet unattended in a pet tub!.It drains remarkably well, with any residual water easily draining out with a slight tilt of the tub. I towel wipe off water droplets & carry it out to the patio to air dry. It is light weight & folds easily for storage.
authors_reviews.author: Mimi

authors_reviews.title: Seriously buy it now!
authors_reviews.text: Omg. I’ve only used this once so far & it has already completely changed the game.I have a little dog who is generally pretty good in the bath, but kneeling on the floor & leaning over the tub while trying to hold on to him used to wreck my back for days afterward. I also always ended up totally soaked & sweaty & exhausted & frustrated from trying to hold him close enough to the water source. Just an exhausting & stressful experience for both of us all around.THIS BATHTUB RIGHT HERE has totally changed everything. Best money I’ve ever spent! I can stand while I bathe him. No more painful awkward strained kneeling.I can clip him to the built in collar to keep him in the right place, which leaves both hands free for washing him. No more struggling with one hand trying to keep him closer to the sprayer end of the bathtub while holding the sprayer in the other & somehow also rinsing him with one hand.The entire experience took far less time & energy than it ever has before. Just so much simpler. And he seemed much less stressed too, 1) because the dog tub is not slippery like my tub, and 2) I’m sure because I wasn’t as uncomfortable & stressed while bathing him.So much easier to lift him out of the tub into his towel afterward too.After the bath I rinsed the tub, dried out the whole thing inside & out with his bath towel, sprayed the inside with Lysol, and let it sit in the bathroom unfolded for a while to fully dry out before putting away to prevent mold/mildew.I also have an older bathtub that is ever so slightly narrower/curved on the bottom than the legs of the dog tub, which made it feel a little wobbly sitting in my tub. So I cut a pool noodle in half, sliced each piece lengthwise on one side, and slipped each half onto the horizontal bottom bar of each leg of the dog bathtub to give it a little more grip and stability in the tub. Lightweight, quick drying, easy to remove after (or not).The ONLY thing I wish is that it was like 6 inches taller as a whole, I wish the legs were like 6 inches longer. Then I wouldn’t have to bend AT ALL. I’m only 5’6 so I imagine it might be a little more difficult for someone who is taller than me, but still way better than kneeling. By a mile. Plus, the pool noodles do help a bit and the fact that it’s faster to bathe him makes things much less uncomfy. Even if I do still have to bend ever so slightly.When fully dry, the whole thing quickly folds up fairly flat/narrow & stores easily in my closet.Seriously, buy it now. Best money I’ve EVER spent!
authors_reviews.author: Mel

authors_reviews.title: Bringing the bath inside
authors_reviews.text: We've been using this awesome dog shower and brush attachment attached to a garden hose and our downstairs shower. It's always been great and allows to have a warm bath, making bath time much more tolerable.Between mosquitoes and heat index, or winter cold, the pups weren't getting the baths we want it. This tub fits perfectly into our shower tub in the basement. It came pre-assembled except for the bottom legs which just snap into place. It is very easy to fold up and out without assistance. The pockets are handy, but a little bit shallow if you're using a large shampoo bottle.Because this shower is hooked up to a sump pump, I used a sink wire drain strainer on the inside, and a wire kitchen strainer under the drain hose. The sink strainer did a great job collecting hair, but would also cause about a half inch to an inch of water to collect until we turn the water off. There is a course strainer that is part of the drain, and it caught quite a bit of hair. The big problem was that the dogs kept stepping on the drain and flipping up the wire strainer I had added. I might take that out in the future. Between the two, there was barely any hair that made it into the bottom strainer which was a complete surprise to me.Since the tub is angled down, you have a bit of water that collects on the drain side of the tub. Not a big deal and you can easily lean the tub to finish draining. It comes with two drain hoses that give you plenty of length if you want to clean them straddling the tub or outside of the tub into another drain.After a lot of research and comparison, it was worth waiting for this one to come on sale. The quality and convenience are there. Inside the waterproof tub are hard plates on both side to give your pup stability and it leans on the metal frame making this incredibly stable. We did not notice any wobbling during the entire bath for both dogs.Bounce will probably become more frequent which will be great for our chiweenie who has a little bit itchy skin, and our fluffball Pomeranian who were using deshedding shampoo on. Spend once, and get it right the first time.
authors_reviews.author: Tony and Melissa ATL

authors_reviews.title: Worth the money!
authors_reviews.text: We have 4 Miniature Schnauzers we groom at home. I’ve been saying I wanted an elevated tub because bathing them is hard on my back (bathing them is my job lol). After narrowing it down based on reviews, I went back and forth between this one and the hard plastic flying pig one but I ultimately chose this one because the price was a bit better, it came with the safety tether (from what I could tell I would’ve had to buy one separately with the other tub), the reviews were better, and it seems more portable since it can easily be folded up and stored if needed.From reading reviews, my only concern was the handle in the middle of the tub. I do wish they had made that recessed, but I purchased a bath mat to go in it when I bought the tub to use which works great!It came in yesterday, only one of our pups needed a bath so she got to be my test subject. It worked great! Fit perfectly in our tub! And no more bending over or kneeling at the tub! I may end up placing it half in/half out of the tub so I have more room to move around but for now, I’m happy with this purchase! It was super easy to set up and although we are leaving it in the bathroom because no one uses that one, I did test folding it up and it was super easy to do that as well! Well worth the money when you have a bad back and/or multiple small or medium dogs!I’ve been saying I want one of these for a while now and my only regret is putting it off for so long.
authors_reviews.author: Robby Bennett

authors_reviews.title: Great Tub For Small Dogs
authors_reviews.text: Very happy with this purchase (the Furesh Little Dipper Dog Bath Tub). The bath is the perfect size for my two Cavaliers, with room to spare. (For reference when looking at the photos, they are about 16 and 19 pounds, and 11 and 12 inches at the withers.) The basin is large enough that they have plenty of room to sit or stand for comfort.There is a plug if you want to retain water in the bath, but I leave it open so the dirty water is draining away as I am washing. There is a neck strap for safety but they still have room to move around in the bath. The tub seems sturdy enough to last, is stable on the shower floor with no wobbling, and a great height for me to work at so it is easy on my back. (I am 5’3”)The drain tubing works well for directing water flow away from your feet and/or into a drain to keep your feet dry (if using inside a tub or shower). I did not need to extend the tubing as I wanted it to go right to the drain beneath the tub (see photo), however there is enough tubing, plus an extension, if you want to direct the water flow further away.My only quibble is there isn’t much of a strainer/hair catcher over the drain so if you have long-haired dogs, you will have to remove hair from that during the bath as it will plug up during the process. For this reason, I tied a knee-high nylon stocking over the drain tubing to catch hair and prevent it from clogging my shower drain. That has been working well and over-all is a way better system than the double strainers I was using previously in a sink.The tub folds up fairly compactly for storage between baths, and, if desired, the legs could be removed again for an even more space-saving option.All-in-all, this is a great little pet tub and by setting it up in the shower where I could use the flexible shower head, I was able to do both dogs in less than half the time it took previously. I have no hesitation in recommending it.
authors_reviews.author: Amazon Customer

other_countries_reviews.title: Best product for small dog owners

I have now used it 3x’s since I purchased it and I am happy to report that I no longer have lower back pain & I don’t dread bath time anymore (even though they dread it lol). It’s also so easy to use as it fits perfectly in the tub & storing it is so easy as it doesn’t take much room & it folds up nicely like a lawn chair. The plug has a hair catcher so it doesn’t go down the drain. The awesome part is you can take it anywhere with you. It is definitely worth every penny and I’m so glad I decided to buy it. The delivery was fast and I was so impressed with the packaging. They also send you an extra drain tube with the tub. My dachshund is almost 20 lbs & it is sturdy enough for her. They also include a safety leash in case your dog needs it which is nice to have.If you are on the fence in buying this I encourage you to do it…you won’t regret it at all!!!

other_countries_reviews.title: It works and saves my knees and back during washing of my dogs!
other_countries_reviews.text: The tub is portable and you can use it in many ways. You can set it up inside the bathroom tub. You can put it half in the tub and half out of the tub for better space management and pet access. And of course you can just place it outside next to the shower. The folding feet are good for different placement of the tub. The unit unfolds and folds easily and snaps into place. The material used is durable and strong and can handle quite the amount of weight. We tried placing the tub half way into our stand up shower and later tried placing it outside of the stand up shower and in both cases we used the existing hand shower spray to clean the pets. The extendable drain tube is plenty long that it can reach even when the unit is outside of the tube or shower and you get a bonus replacement tube as well. When your pet is in the tub, it can wobble when they are startled but over time the pet will get used to the new environment where they get washed. It is easy to clean and fold away when not in use. We wash two of our bulldogs weighing 50 and 55 lbs with no problems. They are able to turn around inside the tub themselves. The width of the tub is actually as wide as some dog seat covers for cars. This is a great idea and it works and it saves your back and/or knees during washing. But it won't save your back or knees lifting them in or out of it even though it is easy to do still.
